remarks.para: This attribute suppresses warnings by the MessagePack analyzer when it encounters references to the specified type within another serializable type.

member.name: P:MessagePack.MessagePackObjectAttribute.SuppressSourceGeneration
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the source generator should not generate a formatter for this type at compile-time.
member.remarks: By default, source generators will generate a formatter for every type that is annotated with this attribute to improve startup performance. However if this leads to malfunctions during code generation or at runtime, it can be disabled by setting this property to . When no precompiled formatter is found at runtime, the DynamicObjectResolver will generate a formatter at runtime instead.

member.name: P:MessagePack.MessagePackObjectAttribute.AllowPrivate
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether generated formatters should allow non-public members to be serialized and deserialized.

remarks.para: This is particularly important to set when is set to if non-public members should be included.

This property can also ensure non-public members are serialized by the DynamicObjectResolver so that the application doesn't have to use DynamicObjectResolverAllowPrivate explicitly for an object to be properly serialized.

member.name: T:MessagePack.GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute
member.summary: Marks a class that implements IMessagePackFormatter<T> so that the MessagePack source generator writes the formatter implementation for T, even when T is declared in another assembly that cannot reference MessagePack.

remarks.para: The formatted type T is serialized in contractless mode, like DynamicContractlessObjectResolver: every public, readable instance property and field is serialized using its name as a string key. Members without a public setter are serialize-only, and deserialization uses the accessible constructor with the most parameters whose names match serialized members. No attributes are required on T.

To control keys and membership without touching T, set to a type whose and annotations describe the wire contract. The surrogate is only read at compile time and is never instantiated at run time. Surrogate members are matched to members of T by name.

member.name: P:MessagePack.GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute.SurrogateType
member.summary: Gets or sets a type whose members define the keys and membership of the formatted type.
member.remarks: Each surrogate member that carries a must match a public, read-write instance member of the formatted type by name. Surrogate members that carry are excluded. All keys in the surrogate must be the same kind (all integer or all string).
